request_robot_job: request the next available robot job from the orchestrator server for a given robot and job type
get_current_robot_job: get the currently active robot job including its job ID and launch command
disconnect_orchestrator: disconnect and clear the current orchestrator server connection for the robot job client
init_orchestrator_robot_job: initialize an OrchestratorRobotJob client with a discovery connection, robot ID, and job type enum
use_job_type_enum: select a JobType enum value like COLLECTION, EVALUATION, or DAGGER when configuring the robot job client
